ev.q: 5,402 reported monkeypox cases occurring among males aged 18–49 years during July 31–September 3, 2022, were analyzed by vaccination status
Average monkeypox incidence (cases per 100,000) among unvaccinated persons was 14.3 (95% CI = 5.0–41.0) times that among persons who received 1 dose

methods_quotes.q: a 95% CI for the average IRR was calculated to account for variation in weekly rates.
